plugin.name: Install PushAside
plugin.description:
PushAside adds physics-based character pushing: actors and objects that collide with the player receive a configurable impulse through the engine's character-proxy interaction callbacks.
What it does: - Hooks the bhkCharProxyController interaction callbacks to observe player/character and player/object collisions. - Applies a per-collision impulse, scaled and oriented by the settings you pick on the next page. - Is fully configurable from Data/SKSE/Plugins/PushAside.ini; delete the file to fall back to the compiled-in defaults.
What it is NOT: - It is not a ragdoll replacement and does not change collision shapes or actor mass. - It does not run any network code; nothing leaves the machine.
This build is a scaffold: the plugin loads and logs its configuration, but the physics push logic is not implemented yet (see README.md TODO). Choose a configuration profile on the next page; it selects the PushAside.ini the manager installs.

plugin.name: Balanced (recommended)
plugin.description:
The tuned default: 100% strength, 150-unit radius, 25% vertical bias, 250 ms cooldown, pushing both actors and objects.
Start here. It is the configuration the push curve is tuned against; the other profiles exist so you can dial the feel up or down without hand-editing the ini.

plugin.name: Strong shove
plugin.description:
175% strength, 200-unit radius, 35% vertical bias, 150 ms cooldown, actors and objects on.
Use it if the balanced push feels too gentle, or for a deliberately chaotic session. A shorter cooldown means more impulses per second, which is more likely to interact badly with other physics mods.

plugin.name: Subtle nudge
plugin.description:
55% strength, 110-unit radius, 10% vertical bias, 400 ms cooldown, actors and objects on.
Use it if you want pushing to read as a shoulder-check rather than an explosion; the longer cooldown keeps it from firing on every incidental contact.

plugin.name: Custom (annotated defaults)
plugin.description:
The compiled-in defaults, fully annotated with a comment on every key. Install this only if you intend to edit Data/SKSE/Plugins/PushAside.ini yourself.
Balanced is the recommended choice; this profile exists so an advanced user gets every key documented in the deployed file instead of only the top-level ones.
